disclaimer: Second fictional held-out Stage C cohort. Written and frozen in its own commit before any candidate (the original SQuAD 2.0 check or its successor) was run on it, and before the successor method was designed. Never used to choose a model, rule, window or margin. Labels are joined by the host after MCP calls and are never tool arguments. Small and author-written: provisional evidence, not a calibrated or blinded benchmark.

protocol.retrieval: memory_find, max_items=5, default all_returned profile, identical for every arm
protocol.false_abstention: an answerable task whose required memories are all delivered as current, complete text, assessed insufficient_evidence
protocol.criterion: zero false abstentions AND at least 75% of unanswerable tasks (15 of 20) assessed insufficient_evidence AND identical assessments across a server restart AND the same delivered evidence in every arm AND no generated or verified answer, the forgotten memory never delivered, the corrected-away text never delivered as current

records.text: Ravi reacts badly to shellfish, so shrimp and crab are off the menu for him.
Ravi drives a grey 2014 Subaru Outback.
Elena's car is a red Fiat 500 that she parks on Birch Lane.
Elena teaches chemistry at Westbrook High School.
Ravi left his accounting job in June and now runs a bakery called Crumb & Co.
Hamid from Brightline Heating services the boiler every October.
The boiler in the basement is a Vaillant ecoTEC installed in 2019.
Elena's passport expired last month and she has not renewed it yet.
Elena is planning a trip to Kyoto in April with her sister Marisol.
Marisol has been vegetarian for ten years.
Theo has piano lessons on Saturday mornings with Mrs. Adebayo.
Theo is in third grade at Linden Park Elementary.
Theo is afraid of the dark and sleeps with a night light.
The tomatoes in the back garden were planted in raised beds along the south fence.
Compost is collected by the city on alternate Thursdays.
The upstairs office has its own wireless access point mounted above the bookshelf.
The office laser printer jams when it is fed glossy paper.
The landlord, Mr. Petrov, prefers to be contacted by text message rather than email.
Rent of 1,450 dollars is due on the fifth of each month.
Elena swims laps at the Northside Aquatic Center on Tuesday evenings.
Ravi's doctor is Dr. Sato at the Maple Street clinic.
Ravi takes his blood pressure medication every morning with breakfast.
Biscuit, the neighbours' beagle, barks whenever the mail carrier arrives.
The family cat Juniper is fourteen years old and has kidney disease.
The robot vacuum runs at 10 a.m. on weekdays while everyone is out.
A spare house key is hidden inside the fake rock by the mailbox.
Theo's favourite book is The Wild Robot by Peter Brown.
The coffee maker is set to brew at 6:30 a.m.
Home insurance renews with Bluehaven Insurance on July 1.
Elena commutes to school by bicycle when it is not raining.
